Colours show elevation, not snow cover. The initial view looks from the northeast, on the Zermatt side.

About the terrain & data sources

A 5 ? 5 km crop of Copernicus DEM GLO-30, sampled from a 1 arc-second digital surface model (AWS 2021 release; heights relative to EGM2008). Horizontal distances use a local latitude-adjusted projection; all three axes use kilometres without vertical exaggeration. Terrain ranges from 2,261 to 4,328 m in this display. The summit marker is a separate reference: the elevation grid reads 4,233 m at that coordinate. A gridded model smooths sharp peaks; this is not a navigation map.
